directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Here's your "goodies". I don't understand why you need that itchy rag. Better buy a vest.
entries.JA_current: Here's your "goodies". I don't understand why you need that itchy rag. Better buy a vest.
entries.JA_new: ほら、あんたの戦利品だ。そんなチクチクするボロ布、何に使うんだ？ ベストでも買えばいいのに。

entries.EN: Heh-heh, you don't know shit about life in the Zone, you little shit. This jacket's got a three-finger layer of cotton inside the lining, and if a pseudo-dog bites onto it, he'll rip out a mouthful of cotton, and I'll be gone. If that same pseudo-dog latches onto your fancy outfit, you'll never get away in one piece. Understand? Besides, you can get a knife in between the ribs for a nice outfit like yours around here.
entries.JA_current: Heh-heh, you don't know shit about life in the Zone, you little shit. This jacket's got a three-finger layer of cotton inside the lining, and if a pseudo-dog bites onto it, he'll rip out a mouthful of cotton, and I'll be gone. If that same pseudo-dog latches onto your fancy outfit, you'll never get away in one piece. Understand? Besides, you can get a knife in between the ribs for a nice outfit like yours around here.
entries.JA_new: へっ、ゾーンでの暮らしを何も分かっちゃいないな、おチビさん。このジャケットの裏地には、指三本分くらい綿が詰まってる。シュードドッグに噛まれても、綿を食いちぎられるだけで俺は逃げられる。あんたのしゃれた服に噛みつかれたら、無傷じゃ済まないぞ。分かったか？ それに、こんな服を着てたら、肋骨の間にナイフを突き立てられるのがオチだ。

entries.EN: Got it, I got it, what about the reward?
entries.JA_current: Got it, I got it, what about the reward?
entries.JA_new: 分かった分かった。で、報酬は？

entries.EN: Don't worry, little man, I'll take care of you. I don't have anything on me, so unfortunately you'll need to do a bit more legwork. I've managed to stash quite a few valuables here and there, here's a location of one of my hidey holes, feel free to grab whatever's in there.
entries.JA_current: Don't worry, little man, I'll take care of you. I don't have anything on me, so unfortunately you'll need to do a bit more legwork. I've managed to stash quite a few valuables here and there, here's a location of one of my hidey holes, feel free to grab whatever's in there.
entries.JA_new: 心配すんな、ちび助。ちゃんと礼はするよ。あいにく今は何も持ち合わせがないんだ。悪いが、もう少し動いてもらう。あちこちに貴重品を隠してある。隠し場所を一つ教えるから、中にある物は好きに持っていけ。

entries.EN: What's in your hiding place, anyway? Probably a couple of dead rats, nothing more.
entries.JA_current: What's in your hiding place, anyway? Probably a couple of dead rats, nothing more.
entries.JA_new: で、隠し場所には何があるんだ？ どうせ死んだネズミが二、三匹ってとこだろ。

entries.EN: Do you think I'm a cheat, little fella? You don't trust me?
entries.JA_current: Do you think I'm a cheat, little fella? You don't trust me?
entries.JA_new: 俺を詐欺師だと思ってるのか？ 信用できないって？

entries.EN: I do, I do. But I'll check.
entries.JA_current: I do, I do. But I'll check.
entries.JA_new: 信用してるって。だが、確認はしておく。
